## Activity

During February 2026, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 102 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume of imaging completed by the site. The capture activity should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and grading results so that any operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9 per cent. This result should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring, with attention given to recurring camera issues that may affect the quality or usability of captures. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 18 referable results during February 2026. The median wait from photograph to grade was 1 day. This measure should be considered with the activity and image quality findings when reviewing the site’s overall performance. Continued recording of delays, image-quality concerns and equipment issues will support timely operational review and help maintain a clear record of service delivery at Oakridge Primary Care.
